thread:
alejandra: Finance flagged a ~€45k GPU bill in eu-west-1 for last month that doesn't match any team's committed reservation claims. Can someone look?
mike: Oof. Do we have the billing export for that period? Could be untagged VMs or preemptible leakage.
chen: Pulling billing_export now. Quick look shows a bunch of compute.googleapis.com/resource/commitment entries attributed to project:default-account and product:UNKNOWN.
alejandra: Here's the small query I ran (billing_export dataset):
```
SELECT invoice_month, sku_description, SUM(cost) as total_cost
FROM `billing_export.gcp_gce`
WHERE invoice_month = '2026-01' AND region = 'europe-west1'
GROUP BY invoice_month, sku_description
ORDER BY total_cost DESC
```
oliver: I think the cluster-autoscaler created nodes via a legacy TF module that doesn't propagate labels. Those VMs end up with no cost center tags so they fall under the default billing bucket.
sre-oncall: Confirmed via gcloud: `gcloud compute instances list --filter='labels.cost_center:*' --project=prod-shared` shows a bunch of GPU instances without labels. Looks like they were provisioned by service account `svc-autoscaler@`.
chen: That service account is used by a shared nodepool (nodepool-shared-gpu). Some product teams rely on the pool for burst capacity. They didn't set node labels at creation, so kubernetes node labels are there but GCP resource labels are missing.
alejandra: Two parallel asks: 1) rectify current month's attribution (finance needs a chargeback mapping), 2) prevent recurrence with an enforcement gate.
mike: For chargeback I propose we compute GPU-hours per IAM service account + node metadata and then apply per-region price multiplier to produce a CSV for finance. We can pro-rate against teams that consumed burst. Not perfect but fair.
oliver: SQL to get instance-level usage: `SELECT resource_labels, SUM(usage_hours) from billing_export.gce_vms WHERE invoice_month='2026-01' AND sku_description LIKE '%GPU%' GROUP BY resource_labels` — but resource_labels is a repeated field in export so will need UNNEST.
chen: I'll prepare a one-off backfill that maps instance->k8s node->pod owner via the node's metadata and kube API. Steps: 1) list unlabeled instances, 2) query metadata for node name + kubelet taints, 3) use `kubectl get pods --all-namespaces -o jsonpath` to map running pods to nodes, 4) infer owning team from pod labels (team, product).
alejandra: We should also run a GCP label backfill: `gcloud compute instances add-labels` in a loop with `--labels=cost_center=<team>` once we map owners. Make sure to do this out-of-hours and annotate for billing snapshot.
sre-oncall: I'll schedule the backfill script on Friday 0100 UTC and run a dry-run tonight. Will post diff and expected CSV.
cost-bot: Automated note: Detected 42 unlabeled GPU instances in europe-west1 for invoice 2026-01. Suggested action: backfill labels and regenerate invoice allocation.
mike: For prevention: implement an admission controller (OPA/Gatekeeper) that requires the following GCP labels on node create: cost_center, project_team, environment. Block node creation without them. Also update TF module to require labels on the instance_template resource.
oliver: We probably also need an autoscaler tweak to set `--service-account` usage to a team-specific SA when scaled from a specific HPA; but that's a broader change. For now, admission controller + TF fix should stop new unlabeled nodes.
chen: Owners and tasks: 
- chen: backfill mapping script + dry-run (due: Thu EOD)
- sre-oncall: run actual backfill and add labels (Fri 01:00 UTC)
- oliver: open PR to TF module to enforce labels + tests (due: next Tues)
- mike: prepare chargeback CSV, include GPU-hours, region multiplier, and commitment offsets (due: Mon noon)
alejandra: Finance wants a reconciliation note: include how much of the €45k was due to untagged burst vs mismatch with commitments. We'll attach the CSV and a short narrative.
mike: One more detail: committed discounts are at org level; some of these unlabeled instances actually used committed capacity that should belong to Team A's reservation — we'll need to cross-check reservation bindings. I'll include reservation_id in the CSV.
alejandra: Thanks team. Keep updates here and ping me if you hit blockers. :thumbsup:
